title: (As Nicola) A fox in the garden

branches.suggestion: Wake up! Wake up! There's a FOX in the garden! A real one! Come and see!
branches.suggestionFa: بیدار شو! بیدار شو! تو باغ یه روباهه! یه واقعیش! بیا ببین!

branches.suggestion: By the shed! It's orange with a white tail tip. It's eating something. Is it eating Daddy's sandwich?
branches.suggestionFa: کنار انباری! نارنجیه با نوک دم سفید. داره یه چیزی می‌خوره. داره ساندویچ بابایی را می‌خوره؟

r3.speaker: mehdi
r3.text: It's eating something from the bin!

translations.fa: داره یه چیزی از سطل زباله می‌خوره!

branches.suggestion: Can I stroke it? Please? It looks like a dog. A soft orange dog.
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونم نازش کنم؟ لطفاً؟ شبیه سگه. یه سگ نارنجی نرم.

r4.speaker: mehdi
r4.text: No, don't go near it. It's a wild animal.

branches.suggestion: OK. I'll just look. Where does it live? In a house?
branches.suggestionFa: باشه. فقط نگاه می‌کنم. کجا زندگی می‌کنه؟ تو یه خونه؟

r5.speaker: mehdi
r5.text: In a den. Maybe under a shed or in the park.

translations.fa: تو یه لونه. شاید زیر یه انباری یا تو پارک.

branches.suggestion: Look! It's got BABIES! One, two, three babies! They're playing!
branches.suggestionFa: ببین! بچه داره! یکی، دو تا، سه تا بچه! دارن بازی می‌کنن!

branches.suggestion: Cubs! Can we give them a name? The big one is Ginger. The little one is Biscuit!
branches.suggestionFa: توله! میشه براشون اسم بذاریم؟ بزرگه زنجبیله. کوچولوئه بیسکویت!

r7.speaker: mehdi
r7.text: Ginger and Biscuit. And the third one?

branches.suggestion: The third one is Mehdi! Because it's clever. Oh no — they ran away. Will they come back?
branches.suggestionFa: سومی مهدیه! چون زرنگه. وای نه — فرار کردن. برمی‌گردن؟

r8.speaker: mehdi
r8.text: Maybe tonight. Foxes come out at night.

translations.fa: شاید امشب. روباه‌ها شب‌ها میان بیرون.

branches.suggestion: Tonight I'll stay awake and watch. All night! Well… till eight. Mummy says bedtime is seven.
branches.suggestionFa: امشب بیدار می‌مونم و نگاه می‌کنم. کل شب! خب… تا هشت. مامانی میگه وقت خواب هفته.
